caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned, symmetrical floral rosette with intricate detailing. The rosette is primarily colored in shades of purple and pink, with darker lines outlining the petals and other elements to enhance the texture and depth. The central part of the rosette features a hexagonal shape surrounded by a ring of small circular forms. Around this center are multiple layers of leaf-like petals radiating outward, interspersed with small rounded clusters at the tips. The edge of the rosette is scalloped, with each scallop punctuated by a cluster of circles resembling berries. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, with no additional objects or decorations besides the central rosette. Below the drawing, the name "Helen Bronson" is printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Tie-back
